# bcm Provider

Terraform provider for Nvidia BCM (BlueField Configuration Manager)

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"

  required_providers {
    bcm = {
      source  = "hashicorp/bcm"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "bcm" {
  endpoint             = "https://172.21.15.254:8081"
  username             = "root"
  password             = "Hashicorp123!"
  insecure_skip_verify = true # Required for self-signed certificates
  timeout              = 30   # Optional: API timeout in seconds (default: 30)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) BCM JSON-RPC API endpoint (e.g., https://172.21.15.254:8081)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) BCM password for authentication
- `username` (String) BCM username for authentication

### Optional

- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. WARNING: This makes connections susceptible to man-in-the-middle attacks. Only use for testing with self-signed certificates.
- `timeout` (Number) API timeout in seconds (default: 30)
